en.t: Who cares? How could anyone care about all that!

units.source_text: 驹子“嗯”地一声，猛然把身子仰了过来滚动着，

en.t: Komako gave a little mm, suddenly threw her body backward, and rolled over,

units.source_text: 岛村被压得难受，想爬起来，

en.t: Shimamura, crushed under her and uncomfortable, tried to get up,

units.source_text: 可因为是突然被惊醒的，摇晃两下，又倒了下去，

en.t: but because he had been startled awake so suddenly, he wavered a couple of times and fell back down,

units.source_text: 头枕在热乎乎的东西上，他不禁吃了一惊。

en.t: and when his head came to rest on something warm, he could not help being startled.
